rows.name: kill_own_descendants
rows.reason_now: r2 delta review C5 (follow-up FU2, V7, W1): SIGSTOP then SIGKILL of the calling process's own descendants only (the /proc ppid tree below os.getpid(), walked again until nothing new appears and every descendant seen is stopped; every signal only to a pid whose start time is still the one recorded); the runner calls it on a Q-HOST abort

rows.name: qhost_monitor
rows.reason_now: r2 Q-HOST (P10; follow-up SF1): the monitor loop. It samples /proc through its MonitorIO, writes a start-of-sample row and a result row per sample with monotonic times, and on a failed sample calls io.signal_parent once and returns; it sends no signal itself

rows.name: start_qhost_monitor
rows.reason_now: r2 Q-HOST (P10): starts the p309_host.py qhost-monitor of this frozen tree as a child (python + a literal .py script), its output into the attempt; the monitor signals only this process

rows.name: stop_qhost_monitor
rows.reason_now: r2 Q-HOST (P10, C4): terminates (then, after 30 s, kills) its own monitor child only, after noting whether it was still alive

rows.name: case_k02
rows.reason_now: r2 follow-up X2: runs the literal SLOWTREE program three times with this environment plus P309_TEST_CODE; SLOWTREE starts two TEST SLOWFORKER processes (512 MB resident, starting TEST children with a real fork for at most 30 s) and calls kill_own_descendants on them; every process carries a random TEST token; anything left is killed by kill_token

rows.name: case_r01
rows.reason_now: r2 follow-up X3: runs the literal RUNSTOP program with this environment plus P309_TEST_CODE and P309_TEST_DIR (a TEST directory under P309_SCRATCH_ROOT); RUNSTOP runs the runner's own start_qhost_monitor / stop_qhost_monitor with a real monitor (interval 4 s; attempt in the TEST directory, label host_rerun: nothing is written in qualification/)

rows.name: case_u
rows.reason_now: r2 follow-up W6, X5 (worker tier only): inside the launched unit, runs the literal Q_CODE program (qhost_preflight) with this environment and P309_LAUNCH_RECORD / P309_HOST_CONFIG pointed at TEST copies in a mode-700 directory under the launch's scratch root (the configuration copy holds TEST bytes only; the record copies are of the redacted launch record), removed at the end; outside a unit it runs nothing

rows.name: kill_token
rows.reason_now: r2 follow-up FU2, X4: cleanup after a failed K01/K02/A01 run; SIGKILLs only live processes whose argv carries the run's random TEST token (only processes the test itself started carry it), repeating until none is left
